system.description: A minor spirit is bound to a stone for 1 hour(s). Spirit: darkvision 5 m, then low-light vision 5 m; load 0.5 kg; 1 m/round. These abilities belong to the spirit, not the Thuul. The GM handles its movement, fetched objects and precise watch instructions; it signals discoveries with the sound of clattering stones.
system.summary: Animates a stone with a mountain spirit, creating a small servant.
